snippet.title: Project ReMind Official Trailer | #TheIndiePremier
snippet.description:
Uncover the mystery behind a vanished artificial intelligence in this first-person puzzle adventure. Manipulate intricate machinery, decipher cryptic clues, and piece together fragmented memories to reveal the truth.

Developed by Red Hog Studio and Full Dive Games, published by Red Hog Studio.
